Record Class OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.order.event.OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord
Record Components:
clientReference - the idempotency key the client submitted the order under
instrumentId - the instrument's id
instrumentName - the instrument's display name
indicativePrice - the price the client saw when submitting
bufferPercent - the price tolerance the order was submitted with
submittedAt - when the order was received
acceptedAt - when the trading rules passed, or null
resolvedAt - when the order was filled or rejected, or null
simulatedAt - the replay time the client traded at, or null
Enclosing class:
OrderStatusEvent
public static record OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord(UUID clientReference, Integer instrumentId, String instrumentName, BigDecimal indicativePrice, BigDecimal bufferPercent, OffsetDateTime submittedAt, OffsetDateTime acceptedAt, OffsetDateTime resolvedAt, OffsetDateTime simulatedAt) extends Record
The order row behind a status change: what a consumer without access to the orders table needs to show the order.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
